content_of_post_to_comment:
i’m thinking of getting a job soon and it made me realize i’m not gonna be able to focus on other things because my work will consume so much of my day. i want to be able to go to the gym 5x a week, work 9-5, focus on growing my social media account and enjoy life with friends and family but i feel like work will exhaust me and i won’t have the energy to do anything after. i also need to get 7-8 hours of sleep

getting a job is a priority right now but so is growing my social media account and im planning on doing social media long term but i only film when the sun is out since that’s the best lighting but if i’m gonna be doing a 9-5 the sun would already be down by then.

going to the gym is also my priority, i can balance gym if i wake up early and do it before work. i’m also thinking about the meal prepping and the time it takes which i might not have.

i don’t know if i’m overthinking it but i really prioritize my time and i’m scared work will just consume me.
comment: The 9-5 probably won’t take every bit of your energy, but the transition period might feel rough at first. You may need to stop thinking in terms of doing everything at maximum effort every day. A few gym sessions, batch filming on weekends when the light is good, and simple meals can still move you forward without burning yourself out.
